116
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, December 20, 2012/Agrahayana 29, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries :  Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; External Affairs; Finance; Overseas Indian Affairs; Panchayati Raj;
Parliamentary Affairs; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;
Planning; Space; Steel; Tourism; Tribal Affairs; Urban
Development; Y outh Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
Self-imposed restrictions on fiscal
and revenue deficits
*381. SHRI C.P. NARAYANAN: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government had self-
imposed any restrictions on fiscal and
revenue deficits of Government, if so, the
details thereof;
(b) whether they are being strictly
followed or violated, the details thereof;
(c) whether deficits increased due to
uncontrolled grant of concessions to various
sections of people; and
(d) the details of concessions given in
the last three years to affluent sections of
people and poorer sections?
Sports authorities in States
†*382. SHRI FAGGAN SINGH
KULASTE: Will the Minister of YOUTH
AFFAIRS AND SPORTS be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the Central Government
introduces programmes for building sports
infrastructure;
(b) if so, the names of the States where
sports authorities have been set up so far;
and
(c) the details of funds allocated for the
establishment of these sports authorities
during the last three years, State-wise?
Education loans to students of weaker
sections
*383. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

117
(a) the detailed criterion adopted by the
public and private sector banks for
disbursing educational loans to students
including students belonging to the
economically weaker sections and those
below the poverty line; and
(b) the details of educational loans
disbursed by the said banks to such
students during the last three years and the
current financial year, bank-wise and State/
UT-wise, including Andhra Pradesh?
Fiscal concessions for investment in
Bihar
*384. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the per capita
income and investment in Bihar is the lowest
in the country;
(b) if so, whether Government is
proposing to introduce any fiscal
concessions in terms of tax breaks through
excise concessions and waiver of corporate
tax and customs duties to attract private
investment in Bihar;
(c) if so, in what manner and by when;
and
(d) if not, what alternative measures
Government has in mind to overcome the
development deficit?
Poor education among tribals
*385. SHRI BAISHNAB PARIDA:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether a United Nations
International Children's Emergency Fund
(UNICEF) based study has painted a poor
picture of education among tribal
community students in the country;
(b) whether it shows that Adivasis in
India receive low-cost, poorest-quality and
indifferently administered education in
India;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether this community still
continues to be marginalized in education
and other Human Development Index
(HDI) sectors; and
(e) if so, the details thereof alongwith
an action plan to address this issue at the
earliest?
Fund’s allocation to Gujarat under
JNNURM
*386. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Gujarat is
the fourth most urbanized State and one of
the fastest urbanizing States of the country;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Gujarat
is allocated only ten per cent of the total
grants under Jawaharlal Nehru National
Urban Renewal Mission (JNNURM);
(c) whether it is a fact that Gujarat is
one of the best States in terms of
utilization of funds and completion of
projects; and
(d) if so, whether Government proposes
to increase the fund allocation to Gujarat
under JNNURM?
Projects pending with DDA
*387. SHRI MOHAMMED ADEEB:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that dozens of
projects relating to hospitals, colleges and
dispensaries etc. are pending with the Delhi
Development Authority (DDA);
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the reasons for the pendency; and

118
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(d) the action being taken to expedite
these projects?
Electronic payment system in towns
and villages
*388. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government plans any
concrete measures to include smaller towns
and villages into the fold of electronic
payment system; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?

to state:
